Thank you for your reply.

A detailed email confirmation will be acceptable, provided it clearly states that:

- the monthly rate of AED ___ is fixed for the entire stay from Apr 23 to Jul 23, 2026  
- the rate will not be subject to any change or increase, regardless of payment schedule  
- the rate is not subject to seasonal adjustments or market changes  

Please include the property name and my reservation details in the confirmation.

Once this is confirmed in writing, I will proceed.
